name: GhostDialogOverlay
description: Headless modal backdrop overlay for GhostDialog. Renders only when the dialog is open and modal is true; marked aria-hidden="true" and excluded from inert isolation.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the modal backdrop.

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport overlay through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Resolved DOM overlay element while open and modal; null otherwise.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the resolved overlay element when mounted.

parts.name: overlay
parts.description: Backdrop element marked with class ghost-dialog-overlay and data-part="overlay".

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while open and modal.
